issue: शरण गहि करुणामयी सुख सम्पत्ति संचार: a statement or a prayer.
our reading: When one takes refuge in the compassionate Mother, happiness and wealth flow in.
alternatives: A prayer: taking your refuge, O compassionate one, (I ask you to) make happiness and wealth flow.

issue: देश देश में भव भौति है: भव भौति is unclear (भव 'existence, arising', भौति 'much'; perhaps भव-भूति 'glory').
our reading: in land after land its glory is great
alternatives: in land after land it has arisen (is manifest) in many places

issue: तेरहुँ मण्ड: what the thirteen are (maṇḍapas, shrines of the thirteen satīs of chaupāī 31, or realms).
alternatives: the thirteen shrines (of Nārāyaṇī and the twelve later satīs)
